narrative:
Good morning, Pilar. Here is your FY2027 snapshot after the October close.

**Revenue** in the 7+5 forecast is EUR 42.19B — EUR 800M (1.9%) below the EUR 42.99B budget and +4.3% on last year.

**Snowflake ML** retrained overnight: November–March EUR 17.52B vs the planners' EUR 17.59B; 4 of 6 segments within 1.5% accuracy.

**Key movements:**
• Germany: −EUR 393M vs budget, steady at about EUR 100M a quarter
• UK (VodafoneThree): −EUR 249M vs budget; ML accuracy 11.3% — keep the planner overlay
• Türkiye: +EUR 9M, the only segment ahead

**Pending your decision:** 3 Snowbot approvals — the October period lock, the ML rolling forecast and two GL mappings.
